# Heydorn om ASLM: Kommer öka produktionen

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-10-14  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Inge Heydorn, a tech specialist and fund manager, is broadly optimistic on semiconductors and AI infrastructure despite growing market worries about returns on AI spending. He treats ASML's report as a litmus test: ASML is sold out for 2027-28, is raising volumes and is taking orders into 2029-30. That points to multi-year demand from TSMC, Samsung and Intel, and he names TSMC as his preferred broad play. He sees hyperscalers Google, Amazon and Microsoft as doing very well, says the verdict is still out on Anthropic and OpenAI, is cautious on software, and avoids auto-component suppliers because China's car market is weak and buying more local components.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 TSM — TSMC | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest's favourite case: dominant in advanced nodes, so a broad play on all chip designers. Sales up >50% YoY; Microsoft's Maia alone adds strong growth next year.

#### Reasoning

Guest Inge Heydorn (fund manager, tech specialist) names TSMC as a good case. All leading chip designers (Microsoft, Broadcom, Nvidia, AMD, Apple) depend on its advanced nodes. That gives exposure to all AI growth without betting on one player. ASML being sold out to 2028 shows TSMC's customer orders run to 2029-30. He says P/E is fairly low given expected growth. He hedges that everything depends on valuation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if TSMC loses its lead in advanced nodes
- if AI capex slows and customers cut orders
- if valuation gets stretched

> *"På det sättet tycker jag att TSMC är ett rätt bra case. Det är ett spel på alla spelare."*

---

### 🟠 ASML — ASML | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Sold out for 2027-28 with +30% volume, plans more capacity in 2028, rising prices and orders coming in for 2029-30.

#### Reasoning

Guest reads ASML's outlook as strong proof of multi-year semiconductor demand. Its customers have order books running to 2029-30, and ASML plans to raise volumes and prices. He is clearly positive but does not explicitly recommend buying the stock, so this is a watch with a positive bias.

#### Sell Triggers

- if customers cancel or push back 2027-28 orders
- if production ramp fails
- if AI investment returns disappoint and capex is cut

> *"Så bolaget säger att man är slutsåld 2027. Man är slutsåld 2028."*
